name: Database connection pool exhausted
query: N/A — no connection-pool utilization signal is emitted anywhere in Phase 5.
threshold: checked-out connections at or near pool_size + max_overflow, sustained
notes: Phase 5 ships SQLAlchemy span instrumentation (query shape/duration via logfire.instrument_sqlalchemy) but no pool-level gauge and no server-side Postgres exporter (pg_stat_activity connection counts, pg_stat_statements). This needs either an application-level gauge reading SQLAlchemy's AsyncEngine.pool.status() emitted as a new sacco_ metric, or a dedicated postgres_exporter feeding Logfire. Not emitted by anything shipped in Phase 5 — staged here so the gap is tracked.
